hook: Eggs hit *₹96* a dozen wholesale in Hyderabad
hook_b: Eggs hit *₹96* a dozen wholesale in Hyderabad
tldr: Wholesale egg prices in Hyderabad rose from about ₹80 to ₹96 a dozen within days, after holding steady since early August.

beats.what: Retail prices went from ₹6-7 to ₹7.50-8 per egg.
beats.why: Traders cite tight supply, lower production and fewer birds in poultry farms; farmers also report higher feed costs.
beats.care: Hostel, PG and home food budgets pay more per egg, with rice and vegetables also up.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Retailers in Meerpet and Bahadurpura say arrivals are not meeting steady demand.

cards.q: Has the price rise changed how many eggs you buy?

qs: Will the hike reach hostel and mess menus?
Is the supply drop local or across South India?

facts.t: Fine rice now costs up to *₹8,000* a quintal, up from ₹6,400 a month ago.

viz.verdict: Rising prices hit buyers; poultry farmers say their costs rose too

watch: Whether supply recovers or prices climb further; traders give no timeline.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Hyderabad egg prices surge, retail rates touch Rs 96 per dozen

fact: Hyderabad eggs jump *₹16* a dozen in days, ending three calm months
twist: Fine rice also rose, from *₹5,600-6,400* to *₹6,600-8,000* a quintal in a month.
